name: Skyrim Together Reborn
author: Tilted Phoques
description: Multiplayer for Skyrim Special Edition, started from its own launcher.
curator_note: The current release is 1.8.4 and supports Skyrim Special Edition 1.6.1170 on Steam and GOG only. It has its own launcher (SkyrimTogether.exe) and needs Address Library; it does not need SKSE. The asset pattern names the 1.6.1170 build and never matches a debug-symbols asset; a new game version needs a new pattern.
